scope: Read-only source, pinned-reference semantics, arithmetic and proposed containment review; no mesh processing, tests, model/native imports, GPU/WSL execution or source changes.
semantics: Unchanged CPU converter preserves original saved coordinate/axis/vertex order, F32 dual sigmoid and softplus transforms, strict positive flags, four-corner membership, supplied-weight q0*q2>q1*q3 split rule, equality-to-split2 and winding. Integer keys sort only membership; returned faces retain original global indices. Original inference grid/AABB branch is (coords+dual)/512-0.5. No clamp, repair, weld, simplification or reorientation is permitted.

memory_projection.includes: Full 104125380-byte tensor payload mapping; contiguous coordinates/dual/flags/weight/vertices; global key/order/sorted arrays; all face chunks plus concatenation; 128MiB batch scratch, 256MiB transform scratch, 256MiB reader scratch, 16MiB degeneracy scratch; PLY write copy, full PLY mapping/comparison and separate NPY readback maps/comparison.
memory_projection.scope: Conservative source-visible projection with explicit scratch allowances, not a measured process/RSS guarantee or exact NumPy allocator proof.
memory_projection.readback_caution: Historical independent_mesh_check has additional unbatched omitted-flag query arrays and whole-edge-incidence arrays. Worst omitted-neighbour coordinates 281936304 bytes, query/position arrays 187957536 bytes each; edge array 281936304 bytes plus starts/counts/r_ copies. Do not claim the unchanged whole verifier fits the extraction-only envelope; review its actual bounded adaptation separately.
memory_projection.map_note: Windows ProcessMemory limits committed private memory, not RSS or file-backed mapped working set; source and PLY mappings add bounded residency.

proposed_containment.owned_job: Reuse existing OwnedJob/ExtendedLimits, KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE with no breakaway.
proposed_containment.launch: Parent creates exclusive attempt marker/logs after input/path/hash and resource gates; child waits for exact GO plus EOF before imports or processing. Attach Job and apply memory limit before GO; install existing no-AI/child/network audit guard, then invoke actual amd_generation_mesh.py CLI via runpy with explicit source/hash/run-contract/output.
proposed_containment.reuse_caveat: Legacy render_host.py is hardcoded Blender and has no startup gate; legacy extract.py hardcodes historical source/support/output. Reuse their ownership and gate patterns, not their unchanged entrypoints.
proposed_containment.cleanup: Query measured peak process/Job committed bytes and natural emptiness; deadline/error closes or terminates only owned Job and preserves failure/partial evidence. No automatic retry.

acceptance_limits: Actual CLI independently rereads all ten source tensors and strict C2S linkage, rejects any zero-area triangles without repair, and verifies PLY readback exactly. Source-generated degeneracy may produce a legitimate fail-closed outcome.
CLI hashes/saves NPY outputs but does not reopen them; separate bounded CPU verification must reopen vertices.npy/faces.npy and compare to PLY before claiming complete readback.
Require unchanged source/contract/provenance identities before and after; actual mesh size/topology/visual quality and process peak remain unknown.

No mathematical support/index/disk blocker found for the proposed 6GiB process/12GiB live host floor/2GiB disk floor/180-second route. Final preexecution clearance depends on exact runner and verifier review, saved positive/denial fixture evidence and live gates.
